expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic ring on granulocytes with lobed nuclei (neutrophils, some eosinophils). Scattered single cells in vessels and lamina propria, sparse in normal gut. Dense clusters only in inflamed, ulcerated or abscess areas.
notes: Both serial sections show a CD66b-bright cluster at the same edge spot, and close up its cells have rings around the nuclei, as granulocytes would. Elsewhere the signal is mostly haze, off-tissue blobs and streaks in the muscle wall. The partner stain shows no cells, so row E tells nothing.
observed: A: haze across the tissue, bright blobs off the tissue, streaks in the muscle wall; one bright cluster at the top edge of the right piece in both sections. B,C: haze that follows tissue layers, a few bright dots. D: yellow rings around nuclei, cell-sized. E: CD11b is a haze with no cells.
why: A cluster of ring-stained cells repeats in both sections, but most of the signal is haze or artefact, so specific cells stand out only weakly.
